comments.body: Much of this has already been resolved for the CRUD operations. The others should also be added to the project README
Thanks for this Yinlin Chen. I am trying to follow your updated README to actually work with the client... stay tuned for comments.
Andrew Woods See comments https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-java-client/pull/16#issuecomment-242565501
Andrew Woods Can you elaborate more on your comment in https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-java-client/pull/16#issuecomment-242562292 regards to "advertised" ?

There are triples and headers that indicate:

  • where versions of a resource can be found
  • where the fixity service for a resource can be found
  • where the endpoint to start a batch-op can be found.

That is what I meant by "advertise". Fedora users should be following these links that advertise the location of various services and resources. Ideally, the the fcrepo-java-client README would illustrate exactly those types of usage patterns.
